findings: For this reading-card task, the inspected Spotlight samples retain the text plane while a soft surface highlight follows input. Tilt samples change the reading plane and apparent type clarity. Favor Spotlight for this particular information task, not as a universal resource ranking.

Adopted chat Thread and ThreadList preserve a complete composer/message arrangement, stream/stop/error presentation and long-content container. Initial narrow shell hid the history entry; the refined adapter restores access through an explicit Threads control.

Initial drawer fixed-delay observations did not establish settled dismissal/focus. The refined adapter uses public controlled-state and focus-return hooks; the final browser observations show zero open dialogs and focus on Review source after close and Escape.

The viewed drawer samples preserve the same surface and note while it follows pointer movement down and back. The footer can move beyond the viewport during a drag; this is not confused with its settled geometry.
limitations: No blind evaluator, independent agent, randomized baseline, full-product parity or user acceptance.
Pointer snapshots include screenshot overhead and prove sampled positions, not natural-time frame pacing or latency.
No mobile hardware touch/keyboard, all-language/theme matrix, production backend, authorization, durable history, upload integration, contrast certification or screen-reader check established.
A record marked viewed:false in original capture files is preserved; this separate review identifies what was later viewed.
